text.p: The Banacci brokerage said on Monday it had raised Mexican forestry products and paper company Grupo Industrial Durango (Gidusa) to a buy rating from neutral.
-- Analysts Gonzalo Fernandez and Antonio Guadarrama wrote in a research report the upgrading was based on an increase in their year-end price target to 80.00 pesos.
-- The analysts said they expected the stock to appreciate on forecast rises in international paper and cardboard prices during the third quarter.
Gidusa A shares were unchanged and trading at 62.00 pesos in mid-afternoon dealing on the Mexican bourse on Monday.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-7912))
